title: Mo’s Distinct Counts
statement:
Use Mo’s algorithm to answer offline queries for the number of distinct values in inclusive ranges.

Input
n q, the n array values, then q lines L R with 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ n.

Output
Print one distinct count per query in input order.

Constraints
1 ≤ n,q ≤ 100000. Values have absolute value at most 10⁹.
